tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 481)༄༅/khrigs su bsdebs pa la sngon 'gro/dngos gzhi/rjes so/dang po la/tho rangs mal nas har gyis ldang la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun lhod chags par bca
481)༄༅/khrigs su bsdebs pa la sngon 'gro/dngos gzhi/rjes so/dang po la/tho rangs mal nas har gyis ldang la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun lhod chags par bca

tei:div.tei:p: 481)༄༅/ khrigs su bsdebs pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ dang po la/ tho rangs mal nas har gyis ldang la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun lhod chags par bca'/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal nas/ ngag byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lce dbang= lan bdun byin gyis brlab bo/ sems gnad kun slong bcos pa ni/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal pa rgyu 'bras gnyis dang bral te mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ snyam du sems bskyed/ de nas dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rgyud skul phyir/ bzhengs su gsol/ zhes snying dbus nas rtsa dbu ma'i lam brgyud spyi bor pad zla'i steng du bzhugs pa la mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas= mthar phyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas gsang gsum gyi yon tan rgyud la zhugs par bsam la mnyam par gzhag go gnyis pa dngos gzhi la thun mong dang*/ khyad par ro/ dang po la/ dal 'byor 482) rnyed dka' ba/ tshe mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ las rgyu 'bras/ thar pa'i phan yon/ bshes gnyen bsten pa dang drug las/ dang po la'ang*/ ngo bo dal ba la bsam pa/ khyad par 'byor pa la bsam pa/ rnyed dka'i dpe la bsam pa/ grangs kyi khyad par la bsam pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du skyes na chos byed pa'i mthu med pas dal ba ma yin pa'i tshul/ da res dmyal= thar pa'i dal ba thob/ ces rang rgyud rten gyi mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes pa la dga' ba bsgom/ gnyis pa rang 'byor lnga dang gzhan 'byor lnga las/ dang po ni/ mi lus rten/ dbang po yon tan/ yul dang bsam pa'i khyad par dad pa ste/ rang ngos la ltos pa dang*/ ston pa khyad par can/ bstan pa chos dang dus/ rang gi skal pa/ lhag pa'i thugs rje ste/

gzhan rkyen la ltos pa'i 'byor pa dang bcu ni/ mi gyur dbang po= bla ma mkhyen= de ltar bco brgyad po tshang na dam chos sgrub pa'i rten yin pas mi lus rin po che zhes bya la/ de las cig shos tsam ma tshang yang thar lam rnal mar 'gro mi nus pas mi lus phal pa zhes bya'o/ 'di lta bu phyin chad rnyed pa ma yin pa'i tshul/ da res dal rten= mtshang re che/ gsum pa rnyed dka'i dpe la bsam pa ni/ rba rlabs chen pos rnam par 483) dkrugs pa'i rgya mtsho'i steng gi gnya' shing bu ga gcig pa yud tsam yang mi gnas pa rgya mtsho'i gting na rus sbal long ba lo brgya brgya'i mtshams la steng du 'ong ba 'dzoms nas gnya' shing gi bu gar rus sbal gyi mgrin pa tshud pa las ni/ mi'i lus rten rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so/ rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ste/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung*/ sbyin sogs dge ba'i bsags rgyab mang pos grogs byed/ smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshams sbyor dgos pas so/ bzhi pa grangs kyi khyad par bsam pa ni/ sems can tsam gyi grangs= bla ma mkhyen= da dung dal ba'i ngo bo tsam thob kyang chos kyi bya ba la mi khom pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ gal mi lus= mkhyen= zhes 'phral byung rkyen gyi mi khom rnam pa brgyad dang*/ skyo shas chung zhing= bla ma mkhyen= zhes ris chad blo yi mi khom pa brgyad kyis rang rgyud chud zos pa'ang zhib tu brtags nas rang mtshang 'don dgos te/ da lta dad dang= chud gson na/ gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa bsam pa la/ dang 484) po snod kyi 'jig rten la bsam ste mi rtag pa sgom pa ni/ 'di ltar gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa'i ra ba sra zhing brtan pa/ bskal pa'i bar du gnas pa 'di dag kyang nam zhig 'jig pa'i dus la bab na me bdun dang chu gcig gis thal ba tsam yang lus par mi 'gyur ba la bsam ste skyo ba bskyed do/ gnyis pa bcud kyi 'gro ba mi rtag par sgom pa ni/

tshe bskal par thub cing gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa'i lha dang drang srong rnams kyang 'chi ba'i gnas skabs las ma thar na/ rang re 'dzam bu gling pa tshe la nges pa med pa'i gnas su dus kyi tha mar skyes pas myur du 'chi ba las ma 'das/ nye du dang longs spyod ni rjes su mi 'brang*/ blos ni mi thongs/ las 'ba' zhig gis rjes su 'gro ba'i tshul/ 'khor dang longs spyod= bla ma mkhyen= don gsum pa 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir lus rten 'di ma bzung bya ba dang*/ phan tshun dgra gnyen 'brel 'dris ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ 'dod pa'i phyir 485) mgo dang yan lag bcad pa grangs kyi mi chod/ srog chags phra mor skyes pa'i yan lag bsdoms na ri rab las kyang mtho/ ngus pa'i mchi ma bsags na rgya mtsho tsam 'ong nges/ tshangs dbang lta bu yang shi ma thag ngan song du skye na/ da lta'i bde skyid rmi lam bde 'phro las sad pa lta bu 'di la snying po ci zhig yod/ de bas 'khor ba'i sdul bya las thar ba la ci nas kyang 'bad dgos/ gnyis pa rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bye brag tu bsam pa la drug las/ dang po dmyal ba la sde tshan bco brgyad kyi tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ yang sos/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med pa ste/ dge sdig las kyi= brgyad mtshan= de nas grang dmyal brgyad ni/ chu bur can dang*/ chu bur rdol ba/ a chu chu/ kyi hud 'don pa/ so tham tham pa/ ut+pal ltar/ pad+ma ltar/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa ste/ gangs ri stug po'i= 'gas te brgyad/ nye 'khor ba ni mnar med kyi 'khor te/ mtshon cha'i thang*/ ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal/ 486) ro myags kyi 'dam/ me ma mur gyi 'obs dang bzhi phyogs re re na yod pa dang*/ mtshams na lcags kyi shal ma li dang*/ nyi tshe ba ni nges pa med pa ste/ de bzhin spu gri'i thang= bla ma mkhyen=

gnyis pa yi dwags kyi sdug bsngal la/ bying na gnas pa dang mkha' la rgyu ba gnyis/ dang po la phyi nang sgos khur gyi sgrib pa can dang gsum/ gnyis pa gnod sbyin gyi rigs gzhan la 'tshe ba rnams te/ de bzhin phongs= ser sna yin/ gsum pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal la/ kha 'thor dang*/ bying gnas so/ dang po ni/ mis bdag tu bzung ba dang*/ ma bzung ba gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ gling bar mun nag gi rgya mtsho sogs la gnas pa de dag gis/ gcig la gcig= bla ma mkhyen= de ltar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal blo la blangs/ der skyes pa la snying rje bskyed do/ bzhi pa mi'i sdug bsngal la/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te rtsa ba'i sdug bsngal gsum dang*/ skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bzhi/ dgra sdang ba dang 'phrad/ gnyen byams pa dang bral/ mi 'dod pa thog tu 'bab/ 'dod pa thog tu mi khel ba 487) ste yan lag gi sdug bsngal brgyad kyi rang bzhin dang*/ lnga pa lha min sdug bsngal la/ rang rang gi gnas ris dang*/ lha rnams kyi dpal 'byor la phrag dog gis 'thab rtsod kho na spyod/ drug pa lha'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'dod lha rnams la 'pho ltung gi sdug bsngal dang*/ khams gong ma gnyis ting nge 'dzin la gnas kyang bden pa mthong ba'i skal pa med pas srid pa 'og mar ltung te sdug bsngal ba'o/ bzhi pa las rgyu 'bras la bsam pa ni/ 'di ltar 'khor ba ni las la skye zhing*/ las kyi 'bras bus byas pa yin pas mtho ris dang ngan song gi gnas su 'gro ba la byed pa po gzhan med cing*/ stes dbang gi 'gro ba'ang ma yin pas rnam pa thams cad du dge mi dge'i rgyu 'bras la dpyad nas spang bya mi dge ba bcu spang zhing*/ bsgrub bya dge ba bcu sgrub pa la 'bad dgos/ de dag la rnam smin dang*/ rgyu mthun dang*/ dbang dang*/ bdag 'bras bzhi bzhi'o/ lnga pa thar pa'i phan yon bsam pa ni/

byang chub gsum gyi go 'phang ni/ zhi ba bsil ba/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi 'phrang las thar ba yin pas de'i rgyu sgrub 'dod bskyed/ drug pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten 488) pa ni/ bla ma ma bsten par sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lo rgyus mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas ma gsungs bas/ gus pas bsten/ spyi bos mchod/ ci gsung sgrubs/ mi mnyes pa skad cig tsam yang med par mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas bsten no/ zhor la rang skyon ngos bzung*/ rang mtshang ther la thon/ rang 'dod yul phud/ chos pa'i gzugs brnyan spong phyir gsol ba gdab pa ni/ chos la zhugs kyang*/ thugs rje bslang bar bya/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la drug skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ rdor sems sgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ ku sa la'i tshogs bsags/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ dang po la gsum/ khyad par dbye ba/ skyabs su 'gro tshul/ phan yon bsam pa'o/ dang po ni/ ngan 'gro la 'jigs nas bde 'gro 'dod pa skyes su chung ngu*/ 'khor ba la 'jigs nas zhi bde 'dod pa skyes bu 'bring*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las bsgral nas byang chub chen por 'god 'dod kyi skyes bu chen po'i skyabs 'gro ste gsum las/ phyi ma la 'jug go gnyis pa ni/ thun mong theg pas dkon mchog gsum po ston pa lam grogs su mos pa dang*/ thun min gsang sngags pas rtsa ba gsum 489) la brten pa dang*/ khyad par ba thabs mchog rdo rje snying pos rtsa rlung thig le sku gsum gyi rang bzhin dang*/ mthar thug bslu med gnas lugs rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro/ skyabs yul gyi thugs ye shes chen po ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum rang rgyud la bsgrub byar byed cing la bzla nas/ dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa ni/ rang nyid 'dug pa'i sa phyogs 'di nyid rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lnga pa/

yal 'dab dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa la rin po che'i 'phyang 'phrul dril g.yer la sogs pas rnam par brgyan pas nam mkha'i dbyings su khyab pa'i dbus su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri stong sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rdo rje 'chang yum dang bcas pa'i rnam pa can la rdzogs chen brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs shing*/ yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mtha' nas bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal ga la sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi yal gar byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun nye ba'i sras brgyad/ g.yon gyi 490) gyi yal ga la mchog zung la sogs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs/ rgyab kyi yal gar chos dkon mchog glegs bam brtsegs pa'i rnam pa can ā li kā li'i rang sgra sgrog pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams thams cad ye shes dang las la grub pa'i chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bar med du gang ba/ thams cad kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi yon tan dpag tu med pas bdag nyid la rjes su brtse zhing*/ 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por bzhugs par gyur pa la pha ma dang gnod byed kyi gtso byas sems can thams cad sa gzhi'i ngos la thal mo sbyar te/ byang chub bar du blo gtad ling bskyur gyis/ dkon mchog gsum= skyabs su mchi: zhes skyabs 'gro 'bum phrag dang khri'i kha skong bcas bya/ mthar bdag dang sems can thams cad skyabs yul rnams la thim/ de dag kyang dbus kyi bla mar 'dus/ de yang stong pa'i ngang la gzhag go gsum pa ni/ thar pa'i sa bon thebs/ sdig pa dag dge ba 'phel/ sdom pa'i rten du gyur/ lhas srung*/ smon pa 'grub/ dkon mchog gi snang ba dang mi 'bral zhing tshe rabs dran/ mthar thug sangs rgyas 'thob bo/ bslab bya yang*/ skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol/

sems can 'tshe ba spang*/ 491) mu stegs mi 'grogs/ so sor gus pa bskyed/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang mi 'gal bar bya/ gnyis pa theg chen gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed pa la gsum/ tshad med bzhis blo sbyong*/ byang chub sems bskyed/ smon 'jug gi bslab bya gzung ba'o/ dang po la dgra gnyen la nye ring chags sdang med pa'i ma yi yul du snyam pa'i gtang snyoms/ bde ba ldan 'dod byams pa sdug bsngal bral 'dod snying rje/ gnas skabs bde ba mi 'bral bar 'dod pa dga' ba'o/ gnyis pa/ sems bskyed kyi dpang po skyabs yul ltar gsal la/ mar shes/ drin dran/ drin lan bzo 'dod/ sdug bsngal bral 'dod/ rnam mkhyen 'god 'dod/ de'i rgyu sgrub 'dod kyis/ hoḥ sna tshogs snang= sems bskyed do: zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar tshogs zhing rang la bstim/ gsum pa la/ smon pa'i bslab bya ni/ bdag bzhin du sems can thams cad bde ba 'dod mnyam/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa mnyam pas bde ba lhan sgrub/ sdug lhan bsal byed pa bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ bdag 'dzin brje ba/ ngar 'dzin brje ba/ gces 'dzin brje ba sogs dbugs kyi rta la bskyon pa bdag gzhan brje ba/ de dag 'byongs nas bdag bas gzhan gces sbyor ba'i lag len la 492)'debs so/ 'jug pa'i bslab bya la/ gtong ba dang*/ yongs su gtong*/ shin tu gtong ba'i sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ chos phyir dka' spyad/ gzhan gyi log sgrub/ zab mo'i don la mi skrag pa'i bzod pa/ sbyor ba/ go cha/ chog shes med pa'i brtson 'grus/ byis pa nyer spyod/ don rab 'byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs dga'i bsam gtan nam/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i shes rab bo/ gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ de la skyabs su bzung nas smon 'jug gi byang sems dang ldan pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi mi dge ba la 'gyod pa nyes byas sun 'byin gyi stobs/
phyin chad dam bca' ba nyes spyod sdom pa'i stobs/ sngar byas kyi gnyen por sgom bzlas byed pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te/ 'don sgom zung 'jug tu/

āḥbadag nyid tha mal= mdzad du gsol: zhes dmigs pa dang mos gus rtse gcig pas thugs ka'i hūṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zla ba zhun ma lta bu babs/ sku yi dbyibs brgyud sbyor mtshams nas bdag nyid kyi tshangs bug 493) nas zhugs/ nad thams cad rnag khrag gdon thams cad srog chags/ sdig sgrib thams cad dud sol khu rlangs kyi rnam par ba spu'i bu ga dang*/ dbang po'i sgo gnyis nas thon/ sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje kha gdangs pa'i lto bar tshud pas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bslus par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pa la ya: badz+ra satwa te no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dri dho me bha ba: su toṣ+yo me bha wa: su poṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhim+me ḍa yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsha me tsitaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wan: sarba ta thā ga ta: badz+ra m+me muñtsa: badz+rī bha ba: ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes 'bum phrag kha skong dang bcas pa bzlas pas/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams kyang bdud rtsis skya mer gyis khengs pa'i rkyen las lus sems zag med kyi bde bas myos par bsam la/ mgon po bdag ni= mnyam par gzhag go bzhi ba mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ snang tshul sprul sku/ gnas tshul longs sku/ khyab byed chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal bcas 'bul ba'i mos pas/ oṃ ā:hūm̐: stong gsum= spyod par shog: ces pa'i bar 494) khri tsho gsum dang*/ bdag gzhan= sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa khri tsho brgyad bsags/ lnga pa bdud bzhi gcig char du bcom pa ku su lu'i tshogs gsog ni/ mdun mkhar drin rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang bcas pas bskor zhing*/ 'og tu rigs drug gnod byed dang bcas pa bca gsal ba la dmigs 'don zung du chud pas/ phaṭaḥ lus gces 'dzin= ma bcos aḥ zhes mnyam par bzhag 'dis ni tshogs rdzogs/ 'chi ba bslu/

nad gdon zhi/ bar do'i 'od gsal zin pa sogs phan yon che'o/ drug pa rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la mngon du byed pa'i thabs kyi mthar phyin pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor la gsum/ tshogs zhing gsal ba/ yan bdun 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa'o/ dang po ni/ snang bas gar khyab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang gi bkod pa dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus su/ dbang gi snod du rung ba/ bde stong ye shes bskyed pa/ rjes su 'dzin ba'i khyad par las/ rang nyid ngo bo mtsho rgyal rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mos gus kyi spyan bla ma'i thugs kar rings pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa'i mdun mkhar gu ru za hor ma 'khor bcas tha mal gyi snang ba rang 'gags su 'gro bar gsal la/ e 495) ma ho: rang snang= ngang du gsal: zhes pas gsal gdab/ dbyings nas ye shes pa spyan drang ba/ hūm̐: o rgyan= sid+dhi hūm̐: gnyis pa ni/ lus grangs med pa sprul pa dang sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas brkyang phyag 'bum phrag kha skong bcas 'tshal ba dang*/ dngos dang yid las byung ba'i byang sems kun tu bzang po'i rjes su 'gro ba'i mchod pa/ thog med bsags sdig stobs bzhis bshags pa/ zag bcas zag med kyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba/ rgyal dang dge ba'i bshes la chos 'khor bskul ba/ mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa la bzhugs par gsol ba/ dus gsum gyi dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo ba'i 'dun pas/ hrīḥ bdag lus= rgyu ru bsngo: gsum pa phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab cing*/ rgyu rdo rje bzhi yi ngo bor sgrub pa ni/ 'di ltar dpal mgon bla ma dam pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gong du he ru ka'i ngo bor dbang rdzogs/ thugs ye shes chen po rtogs rung ma rtogs rung ye nas ye sangs rgyas pa yin la/ de sku ltar shar bas snang stong sku rdo rje/ gsung ltar grags pas grags stong gsung rdo rje/ thugs ltar shar bas rig stong thugs rdo rje/

gang mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi phrin las/ rang ngor 496) sangs rgyas las bka' drin che la/ skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i spyi gzugs yin pa dang*/ gsol ba btab na lam rkyen gzhan la ma ltos par rtogs pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la skye ba ste/ bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa lnga'i mos gus gdung ba drag pos/ rje btsun gu ru= pad 'byung mkhyen: zhes pa yan chad tshar ci nus dang*/ bdag la= nus mthu can: zhes pa yan chad tshar 'os mtshams kyi rjes su/ gsol 'debs rgyud bskul gyi rnal 'byor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sad+dhi hūm̐: zhes 'bum phrag brgya yi bar du chig sgril du 'bad/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ e maho: rgya chad= snying nas gdab bo/ de nas dbang bzhi len pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bla ma la gdung ba drag po'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid la brtse bas rjes su dgongs te/ gu ru'i= lam dbang blangs mthar/ rdzogs rim bsdu ba'i dmigs pa zab gnad can 'di nges par gces te/ nam zhig= mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i tshig brjod pa dang chabs gcig slob dpon chen po la gdung ba shugs drag po bskyed pa'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid la thugs rje'i 'jug pas shin tu dgongs par gyur te/ bla ma'i thugs 497) ka nas= mnyam par gzhag go de las ldang ba na/ dpal ldan= rdo rje 'chang gi gong 'phang myur 'thob shog ces brjod/ thun mjug bsngo ba ni/ de ltar bsags pa'i rnam dkar gyi dge rtsas mtshon zag bcas zag med kyi dge rtsa thams cad sems can gzhan don du 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pas bsngo ba'am/ rjes mthun gang rigs kyi 'dun pas/ dge ba 'di= bsngo bar bgyi/ smon lam khyad par can gdab pa ni/ gang du skyes= sangs rgyas thob par shog ces dang zangs mdog dpal ri'i smon lam kyang gdab pa gnad dam pa'o/ thun bcad pa la chod dam ma chod brtag gzhig byas pas/ dga' zhing nga rgyal ba'ang bcag sdug cing yi chad pa'ang bsring dgos te sems bar ma la lam shes skye bas so/

mos gus dang dam tshig rnam par dag pa/ gang zhig 'di yan chad kyi lam mthar phyin pas kyang dngos gzhi la mi ltos par rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor 498) dbugs dbyung*/ dag pa'i zhing khams der rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i lam nyi zla'i bgrod pa las kyang myur bas kun tu bzang po'i sa la phyin par 'gyur ro/ zhes rdzogs pa chen po klong chen pa lta bur gyur cig slar yang sgrub brtson rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dam pa pad+ma rat+na'i thugs bzhed bzhin rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pas khrid yig rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bzhin don bsdus su bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis//
